stories.title: Former Broncos star, ESPN broadcaster Tom Jackson dead at 75
stories.summary: Broncos legend and ESPN sportscaster Tom Jackson has died. He was 75.

stories.title: Fiona to be honored at upcoming Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: Macy’s has announced that Fiona will be honored at the upcoming 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade.

stories.title: Chadwick Boseman’s father, Leroy Boseman, dies at 82
stories.summary: Leroy Boseman, the father of actor Chadwick Boseman, died at 82 after a brief illness, according to a statement from his family. The family announced his death Saturday.

stories.title: Father stabbed to death by ex in middle of the night in front of 3-year-old son, authorities say
stories.summary: A family is grieving after a father was allegedly stabbed to death by his ex in the middle of the night in front of their young son.

stories.title: Hawaii football falls to Nevada, 16-8, on the road
stories.summary: The Rainbow Warriors remained scoreless through the first three quarters as Nevada built a 13-0 lead.

stories.title: ‘Unacceptable’: Green vows investigation into H-POWER leak, response
stories.summary: Gov. Green plans to hold a news conference next week to provide additional information about the investigation and response.

stories.title: Le Jardin Academy celebrates Arbor Day with tree planting in Kailua
stories.summary: Volunteers helped remove invasive species and plant native trees and other native plants, many of which were grown in the school’s own nursery.

stories.title: Hawaii State Library reopens after partial ceiling collapse
stories.summary: Safety measures have since been installed, allowing the library to reopen at 9 a.m. Saturday.

stories.title: Rainbow Wahine fall to Gonzaga 63-57 in North Shore Showcase
stories.summary: Rainbow Wahine guard Bailey Flavell led Hawaiʻi with 12 points, while Ritorya Tamilo and Kelsie Webb each added 11 points.

stories.title: Hawaii businesses push USPS to reverse shipping policy
stories.summary: Hawaii small businesses say a U.S. Postal Service policy change is delaying shipments to the mainland, hurting sales and frustrating customers.

stories.title: Bigfoot files quietly released by US Forest Service
stories.summary: Forest Service records describe reported Bigfoot tracks in Montana and Washington, including an investigation that found signs of a possible hoax.

stories.title: 2 injured in multi-vehicle crash on H-1 Freeway near Waimalu
stories.summary: Honolulu Emergency Medical Services responded to the crash around 3:13 p.m. in the westbound lanes.
